title: Vegan Tabbouleh Salad
description: A refreshing vegan salad made with parsley, bulgur, and a hint of citrus. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Chop the parsley and place it in a large bowl.
Add the soaked bulgur to the bowl and toss to combine.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the parsley and bulgur mixture.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top and sprinkle with zaatar.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in the tabbouleh.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
